item.name: Las Vaquitas Saturnitas Ritual
item.cardSummary: A three-player triangle ritual that summons Las Vaquitas Saturnitas and starts a meteor shower.
item.formation: Three players hold La Vacca Saturno Saturnita in a triangle, with all three Brainrots facing the center.

item.name: Bombardiro Crocodilo Ritual
item.cardSummary: A three-player line ritual that summons Los Crocodillitos and triggers the Explosive event.
item.formation: Three players hold Bombardiro Crocodilo in a line near the red carpet, spaced closely and facing forward.

item.name: Orcalero Orcala Ritual
item.cardSummary: A four-player line ritual that summons Los Orcalitos and floods the map with the Ocean event.
item.formation: Four players hold Orcalero Orcala in a forward-facing line, with one player positioned slightly behind the others.

item.name: Matteo Ritual
item.cardSummary: A vertical three-player stack that summons Los Matteos and grows the Matteo event tree.
item.formation: Three players hold Matteo and stack vertically on top of one another while facing the same direction.

item.name: Sammyni Spyderini Ritual
item.cardSummary: A four-player square ritual that summons Los Spyderinis and covers the map with the Spyder Invasion event.
item.formation: Four players hold Sammyni Spyderini in a square at the center of the map without standing on the red carpet.

item.name: Chicleteira Bicicleteira Ritual
item.cardSummary: A two-player tunnel ritual that summons Los Chicleteiras and turns the red carpet into a painted road.
item.formation: Two players hold Chicleteira Bicicleteira on opposite sides of the spawn tunnel near the start of the red carpet, facing forward.

item.name: Dul Dul Dul Ritual
item.cardSummary: A four-player square ritual with two possible exam-themed spawn results.
item.spawns: Yess my examine or Noo my examine
item.formation: Four players hold Dul Dul Dul in a square near the spawn tunnel without touching the red carpet; one remains to give the speech after the other three disappear.

item.name: Karkerkar Kurkur Ritual
item.cardSummary: A four-player formation that starts musical chairs and sends Los Karkeritos to the winner's base.
item.formation: Four players hold Karkerkar Kurkur in a rhomboid formation, then complete the musical chairs minigame.

item.name: Guerriro Digitale Ritual
item.cardSummary: A time-gated four-player tunnel ritual with three possible digital Brainrot results.
item.formation: During the 3 AM Eastern ritual window or Admin Abuse, four players hold Guerriro Digitale in a square around the container inside the spawn tunnel.

item.name: Mi Gatito Ritual
item.cardSummary: A two-player face-to-face ritual that summons Los Mi Gatitos and triggers the :3 event.
item.formation: Two players hold Mi Gatito while facing each other closely enough for the Brainrots to hug.
